archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Professional SaaS for UK Driving

global_rules.language: Strictly British English (e.g., manoeuvre, centre, colour, tyre, categorised)
global_rules.responsiveness: Mobile-first. Use bottom navigation and full-width cards on mobile. Automatically adapt to side navigation rail and two-column layouts on tablet (>=md).
global_rules.interactions: Pull-to-refresh on lists, smooth bottom-sheet slide-ups for forms/details, loading spinners during auth.

components.buttons: Min 48px height for touch targets. Primary actions in Blue. Prominent 'Students' button MUST be Orange.
components.bottom_sheets: Use rounded-t-3xl, slide up from bottom, handle bar at top.
components.cards: White surface, subtle border, no heavy drop shadows to maintain clean look.

auth.layout: Full screen mobile, centered max-w-md card on tablet.
auth.elements: Sign In / Create Account tabs, Demo credentials panel, Loading state, ToS & Privacy links.

instructor_home.elements: KPI Grid (Pass Rate, Active Students), MTD Status panel, Earnings Chart, Today's Lessons. QUICK ACTION: Orange 'Students' button.

lesson_diary.elements: Week navigation, Add Lesson bottom sheet, Lesson Detail bottom sheet.

student_crm.elements: Searchable list, Status badges (Active/Test Ready/New), Add New Student FAB with bottom sheet form, Success snackbar.

student_home.elements: Driving Readiness Card, Mock Test Access, Lesson Feedback, Bottom Nav (My Learning/Mock Test/Profile).

dl25_mock_test.elements: Buttons for Driving faults (minor), Serious faults, Dangerous faults. Pass/Fail report.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
